name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: The adventurer with the Hawk familiar's gold is immediately below Mara.
The adventurer with the Owl familiar's gold is higher than both the adventurer with the Cat familiar and the adventurer with the Hawk familiar.
Fenwick's gold is immediately below the adventurer with the Toad familiar.
The adventurer with the Wolf familiar's gold is at least 10 gp more than Fenwick.
The adventurer with the Cat familiar has a higher gold than Wrenna.
The adventurer with the Toad familiar's gold is between the adventurer with the Cat familiar and Kael.
